row.name: Battle Meditation
row.effect: Coordinate Small Team: Affects up to 5 allies within a 20-foot radius. You can grant one ally a +1 bonus to any skill roll once per round. Simultaneously, one enemy in the radius takes a -1 penalty to their Leadership or Tactics skill.

levels.name: Battle Meditation
levels.description: The Force-user becomes a focal point of strategy and morale on the battlefield. By extending their senses and will through the Force, they can guide their allies with uncanny prescience while sowing seeds of doubt and confusion among their enemies.

levels.effect: Inspire Strike Team: Affects up to 15 allies in a 100-feet radius. All allies gain +1 to their attack rolls. All enemies in the radius make a Will roll each minute or suffer a -1 penalty to their own attack rolls from eroding confidence.

levels.effect: Guide Battalion: Affects a large combat force in a battlefield-scale radius. All allies gain +1 to all skill rolls (attack, defense, etc.). All enemies suffer a continuous -1 penalty to their Will rolls and morale checks.

levels.name: Battle Meditation
levels.description: The Force-user becomes a focal point of strategy and morale on the battlefield. By extending their senses and will through the Force, they can guide their allies with uncanny prescience while sowing seeds of doubt and confusion among their enemies.
levels.effect: Master of Fleets: Affects entire armies or fleets. All allies gain +1 to all skill rolls and +2 to Will. All enemies suffer a -1 to all skill rolls and must make a Will roll at -2 each round to avoid hesitation or breaking morale. You can issue silent, instantaneous commands to your entire force.
